panels.title: Price <-> Sentiment (hourly, 7d) - left axis $, right axis +/-1
panels.description: Solid blue = hourly close price (left, USD). Solid purple/blue = VADER / BERT compound sentiment (right, [-1, 1]). Dotted = sentiment shifted 1h / 2h ahead - toggle in legend to see if sentiment leads price. Watch for sentiment spikes preceding price spikes. Pink/cyan lines = rolling avg over last 100 tweets/coin (refreshed every 60s; covers gaps when scraper is bursty). Hover for sample size + age - older than 30min suggests scraper lag.
